This hotel features an on-site restaurant and bar, as well as a spa center. With the soft beige color of the fabric and the brown color of the wooden furniture, all soundproofed rooms are equipped with air conditioning, as well as a work desk and wardrobe. There is also a personal safe, cable TV, minibar and electric kettle. Some rooms offer city views. The private bathroom comes with shower facilities, a hairdryer and free toiletries. Hong Ngoc Dynastie Boutique Hotel & Spa operates a 24-hour front desk where staff can assist with luggage storage, currency exchange and other concierge services. Day trips, scheduled airport transfers and car/motorcycle rentals can be arranged at an extra charge at the tour desk. Hong Ngoc Dynastie Boutique Hotel & Spa is 350 km from St. Joseph Cathedral and 750 meters from Hanoi Citadel. The nearest airport is Noi Bai International Airport, 21 km away. Rice Bistro restaurant on the first floor will serve traditional Vietnamese dishes as well as refreshing cocktails. Welcome to Hong Ngoc Dynastie Boutique Hotel & Spa to experience the best services!
